message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Category | Typical Ingredients |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Lasagna Noodles** | 12–15 sheets (regular or no‑boil) |
| **Meat Sauce** | 1 lb ground beef or a mix of beef & pork, 1 onion (chopped), 2–3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce, 1 can (6 oz) tomato paste, 1 cup beef or vegetable broth, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried basil, salt & pepper to taste |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | 15 oz ricotta cheese, 1 egg, 1/2 cup grated Parmesan, pinch of nutmeg, salt & pepper |
| **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (or sliced) |
| **Parmesan** | 1 cup grated (for topping) |
| **Optional Extras** | 1 cup shredded mozzarella or provolone, 1/2 cup shredded cheddar, sautéed spinach or mushrooms, fresh basil or parsley for garnish |

**Basic Assembly Steps**

1. Cook noodles until al dente, drain, and lay flat on a sheet of foil or parchment to prevent sticking.
2. Prepare the meat sauce: brown the meat, add onion & garlic, stir in tomatoes, broth, herbs, and simmer for 20–30 min.
3. Mix ricotta with egg, Parmesan, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
4. In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of sauce, then layer noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and sauce. Repeat until all layers are used, finishing with a generous layer of sauce and mozzarella.
5. Sprinkle grated Parmesan on top.
6. Cover with foil and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
